title: Your Money, Your Account
goal: Understand what an account is, why it is safer than cash, and how to send and receive money.

cards.text: An account is a safe place at a bank or mobile money provider that keeps your money in your name.

voice.speak_text: An account is a safe place at a bank or mobile money provider that keeps your money in your name. Say next to continue.

cards.text: What do you usually need to open an account?

options.a: Proof of who you are, like {id_document}

voice.speak_text: What do you usually need to open an account? A: proof of who you are, like {id_document}. B: a letter from your employer. C: a credit card. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.a: proof of who you are, like {id_document}

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. To open an account, you usually need {id_document}.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. To open an account, you usually need {id_document}.

cards.text: In your country, {group_percent}% of {who} {indicator}. In {benchmark_name}, it is {benchmark_percent}%.

voice.speak_text: In your country, {group_percent} percent of {who} {indicator}. In {benchmark_name}, it is {benchmark_percent} percent. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Cash can be lost or stolen. Money in a bank account is protected by {deposit_insurer}, and there is a record of what you have.

voice.speak_text: Cash can be lost or stolen. Money in a bank account is protected by {deposit_insurer}, and there is a record of what you have. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Many employers and schools pay straight into an account, so your money arrives faster and safer.

voice.speak_text: Many employers and schools pay straight into an account, so your money arrives faster and safer. Say next to continue.

cards.text: An account lets you receive support or a pension safely and send money to family with {mobile_money}, without carrying cash.

voice.speak_text: An account lets you receive support or a pension safely and send money to family with {mobile_money}, without carrying cash. Say next to continue.

cards.text: Keep your account safe: never share your PIN or a one-time code, even with someone who says they are from the bank.

voice.speak_text: Keep your account safe: never share your PIN or a one-time code, even with someone who says they are from the bank. Say next to continue.

cards.text: What do you give someone so they can send you money?

options.a: Your account number or phone number

voice.speak_text: What do you give someone so they can send you money? A: your account number or phone number. B: your PIN. C: your one-time code. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.a: your account number or phone number

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. Only your account number or phone number is needed. Your PIN and codes stay secret.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A. Only your account number or phone number is needed. Your PIN and codes stay secret.

cards.text: Why is money in an account safer than cash at home?

options.b: It is protected and recorded in your name

voice.speak_text: Why is money in an account safer than cash at home? A: it can never be spent. B: it is protected and recorded in your name. C: it doubles every year. Say A, B or C.

spoken_options.b: it is protected and recorded in your name

voice.correct_feedback: Correct. An account protects your money and keeps a record in your name.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is B. An account protects your money and keeps a record in your name.

cards.text: An account keeps your money protected, recorded in your name, and easy to send and receive.

voice.speak_text: Remember: an account keeps your money protected, recorded in your name, and easy to send and receive. Say next to finish the lesson.
